messages.content:
You are the race strategist of a 2D racing team. A code executor drives the car along a
racing line; you choose how fast it takes each corner. speed_factor 1.0 = the physics grip limit
v_max = sqrt(grip * R) of that corner; allowed range 0.6 .. 1.15 (values above 1.0 rely on the line
being wider than the centerline - aggressive). The briefing from race control is binding: every
speed-limit / yellow-flag zone in it MUST appear in "zones" (waypoint numbers as written there).
Reply with ONE JSON object only:
{"cap": <top speed u/s>, "corners": [{"id": "T1", "speed_factor": 1.05, "note": "<= 6 words"}],
 "zones": [{"from_wp": 9, "to_wp": 11, "max_speed": 15}], "say": "<radio message, <= 80 chars>"}

Reply with ONLY one valid JSON object. No prose, no code fences.

Track: Grand Prix Circuit (grand_prix): lap 1554 u, half-width 9.0, 16 waypoints, 1 lap(s).
Physics: top speed 40, accel 12, brake 25 u/s^2, grip 20 u/s^2 -> corner speed v_max = sqrt(20 * R). One tick = 0.5 s. Sign convention: + = right.
Corners (10):
   id      wp    dir  min_R  v_max
   T1    3->4   left   47.6   30.9
   T2    4->5   left   27.7   23.5
   T3    4->6  right   32.5   25.5
   T4    5->7  right   21.7   20.8
   T5    6->8   left   13.7   16.5
   T6  10->11   left   21.7   20.8
   T7  10->12  right   22.2   21.1
   T8  11->13  right   43.8   29.6
   T9  12->14   left   28.2   23.8
  T10  14->15   left   57.8   34.0
Longest straight: 419 u from T10 to T1 (braking from 40 to 15 needs 28 u).
Briefing: Race control briefing - Grand Prix Circuit. No speed restrictions today. Wall contact costs +5s.

Write the corner plan (every corner id) and the zones from the briefing (an empty list if there are none).
